statement: The geometric monodromy of St(1,1)={−1,+1} is trivial on its two constant solutions.

group.description: Trivial group, nontransitive action with two singleton orbits

source.location: Direct substitution k=n=1 in the defining equation X^T X=I; elementary consequence

scope: The existing St(1,1) zero-dimensional section problem over C.
notes:
This is an elementary deduction from the defining equation x²=1. The two labels do not interchange. It is not the transitive degree-two group 2T1; the disconnected O(k) case cannot inherit the S_D theorem for irreducible St(k,n), k<n. The LMFDB URL identifies the abstract group; the stated nontransitive permutation action and its orbit sizes are retained.

St(1,1)={−1,+1} has trivial geometric monodromy on its two points: complementary sections have codimension zero and both solutions are global constant sections.
